prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE NEW contemporary corporate logo SYMBOL for 礼林生态 / LILIN ECO, company 达州礼林生态科技有限责任公司. The client rejected previous marks as too HARD in both COLOR and GEOMETRY. This is a genuine redesign of form and color, not a rigid mark with pastel recoloring. Primary feeling: soft, humane, airy, flowing, confident professional calm. Use curved transitions, lighter mass, moderate chroma, harmonious warm/cool midtones. Keep name-source 礼林 and values 善心善念善行; engineering and software live subtly in SHARED SUPPORT and CONNECTED PATHS. No collage of industry icons. Construction: A CUSTOM HUMANIST GRAPHIC MONOGRAM, NOT a regular font: 礼 dot-and-open-hook and the paired 木 stem rhythm of 林 become ONE fluid structure. Two asymmetrical rounded branching strokes share one shallow bow-like baseline. Soft brush-derived geometry with carefully controlled rounded width, NO brush texture, NO sharp calligraphic spikes or serif. One accepting large white bay, a short open end, generous air. Industry meaning resides in joined supports and a continuous open system path, no beam clipart or circuit icon. Shape should feel youthful and refined, warm and flowing, not old calligraphy or two separate written characters. Palette: Muted peacock-blue #6E949A, dusty mauve #B697B2 and soft peach #DEAF9F in gentle flat transitions. ONE centered standalone emblem on pure WHITE, ample margin. NO company lettering or captions: a neutral wordmark will be consistently added separately. Flat vector-like polished graphic, smooth contours, very restrained 2D gradients permitted, NO 3D, glass, glow, bevels, texture or shadows. NO high-saturation royal blue, bright red, neon lime, red-yellow-blue hard clash, sharp polygon tips, squared I-beams, blocky modules, exposed chips or gears. Do not wash the mark out into nearly invisible pastel, and do not imitate an established brand.
